{{Quote|A ceremonial Gran wind drum. Over one thousand years old. A present from Baskol Yeesrim.|Senator Palpatine presenting his collection to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]]|<ref name="Darth P" />}}
'''Wind drums''' were ancient ritual [[Music/Legends|musical instruments]] once used by the [[Gran/Legends|Grans]],<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|32|COR 11-12|Coruscant &ndash; Palpatine's Apartments}}</ref> a three-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]], [[Goat/Legends|goat]]-faced [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]].<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> Such drums performed a ceremonial function<ref name="FF" /> at some point during the [[New Sith Wars|Draggulch Period]],<ref name="Era">In the novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], it was mentioned that [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] wind drum was "over one thousand years old" as of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], which places its date of fabrication around [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]. According to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', the [[New Sith Wars|Draggulch Period]] lasted from approximately [[2000 BBY/Legends|2000]] to [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].</ref> while the Gran society went through a spiritual [[Time/Legends|era]].<ref name="FF" /> The Gran [[Baskol Yeesrim/Legends|Baskol Yeesrim]], who [[Senator/Legends|represented]] the world of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], once offered his colleague [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] one such relic.<ref name="Darth P">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> That particular wind drum was a barrel-shaped object decorated with stylized [[Plant/Legends|flowery]] motifs,<ref name="TPMIG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> and was at least one millennium old at the time.<ref name="Darth P" /> It was displayed in the reception room of the Nabooian politician's [[Palpatine's apartment/Legends|apartment suite]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="FF" />

==Behind the scenes==
A Gran wind drum first appeared in the [[1999]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], the first installement of the ''Star Wars'' [[prequel trilogy]], as a background prop on the set of Palpatine's apartement.<ref name="TPMIG" /> Its in-universe origins were revealed in later sources, including the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 32|thirty-second issue]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'',<ref name="FF" /> and the wind drum was mentioned in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']].<ref name="Darth P" />
